rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a preconceived view or fixed opinion formed before judging the facts.

example.english: Don't form a preconception so quickly; hear both sides first.
example.traditional: 唔好咁快有成見，要聽晒雙方講法先。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 jau5 sing4 gin3 jiu3 teng1 saai3 soeng1 fong1 gong2 faat3 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the preconception specifically involves bias or an unfair prejudice.

example.english: That hiring policy is based on a preconception and is unfair to older people.
example.traditional: 嗰份招聘制度有偏見，對年紀大嘅人唔公平。
example.jyutping: go2 fan2 ziu1 ping3 zai3 dou6 jau5 pin1 gin3 deoi3 nin4 gei2 daai6 ge3 jan4 m4 gung1 ping4

rows.jyutping: sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2 ge3 nam2 faat3
rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that an earlier impression or idea shapes someone's later judgment.

example.english: You had a preconception about him from the start, so nothing he did looked right to you afterward.
example.traditional: 你一開始對佢有先入為主嘅諗法，之後點睇佢都唔順眼。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 deoi3 keoi5 jau5 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2 ge3 nam2 faat3 zi1 hau6 dim2 tai2 keoi5 dou1 m4 seon6 ngaan5
